newsitem.title: UK: Senior Engineering unit sale delayed.
newsitem.headline: Senior Engineering unit sale delayed.

text.p: Senior Engineering Group Plc said on Friday that the disposal of its thermal engineering division to Thermal Engineering Corp had been delayed.
The company had expected to complete the sale, which it previously valued at 28.25 million stg, at the end of October.

The company said that since September 30, forecast profit from the division had been revised downwards by about one million stg as a result of higher actual and forecast costs within the unit's industrial boilers business in the UK and the winning of less repair work than expected in the U.S.
Senior said Thermal Engineering remained committed to the purchase and was arranging financing with a view to completion taking place on or before December 20.
Either company may terminate the agreement if completion of the sale has not taken place by December 20.

"In the meantime, we will be laying plans to strengthen the management of the business and where appropriate implementing improvements whilst continuing to progress its disposal," Senior Engineering said.
"Our core Flexonics business is continuing to trade strongly and confirms our confidence in the group's trading prospects for the year," it added.
